plan.summary:
Snapshots are now identified by a `SnapshotKey` (project plus id) instead of a bare UUID.

- `stale` in `src/snapshots.rs` returns `SnapshotKey` values.
- `stale` now also treats entries that expire exactly at `now` as stale (`<=` instead of `<`).
- `shouldFlush` in `src/flush.ts` now returns true when `force` is set, even with nothing pending.
plan.riskRationale: Small changes, but they alter a return type, an expiry boundary, and a flush condition. No tests are shown in the diff.
plan.storyArc: The PR changes snapshot identity to a project-scoped key and updates stale selection to match, with a boundary change. A separate small fix makes `shouldFlush` honor `force`.

topics.title: Project-scoped snapshot keys and stale boundary
topics.narrativeBrief: How does `stale` change its returned identity type, and what changes at the expiry boundary? Verify that callers accept `SnapshotKey` and that the `<=` change is intended.

topics.title: Flush when forced
topics.narrativeBrief: When does `shouldFlush` return true now? Show that `force` triggers a flush even when `pending` is empty. Verify that callers pass `force` as intended.
